title: VoxClip settings file (<data>/settings.json), voxclip-settings/1
description: One flat JSON object with dotted keys, identical on macOS and Windows (doc/architecture.md section 2.5). A missing key means its default. Writers write every key they changed and may omit keys at their default. Unknown keys are preserved on save (a newer VoxClip may have written them), so additionalProperties is allowed; tests check that the apps write only the keys listed here. No secret ever appears in this file: API keys live in the Keychain / DPAPI (architecture section 11.4). The owning spec of each group is named in its description.

general.transcriptTextSize.description: Transcript font size in pt (macOS) or epx (Windows); null is the platform default (macOS 15, Windows 19). design.md section 4.1.

ui.rightColumnWidth.description: Width of the editor's right column in pt (macOS) or epx (Windows) after the user drags its divider; null is the platform's width-dependent default, and each platform clamps to its own range. Windows reads it; macOS removes it at launch and uses ui.layout.rightWidth instead (v2 shell). design.md section 3.

ui.layout.explorerWidth.description: macOS only until Windows WV1: the Explorer pane's width in pt after the user drags its divider. Missing or null is the 224 pt default; the app clamps to 220-320. No shared default, so it is absent from the Windows defaults.

ui.layout.rightWidth.description: macOS only until Windows WV1: the right column pane's width in pt after the user drags its divider. Missing or null is 404 + (window width - 1280) x 0.25, narrowed so the transcript keeps its minimum; the app clamps to 300-560.

ui.layout.timelineHeight.description: macOS only until Windows WV1: the bottom timeline panel's height in pt, below its 1 pt top edge, after the user drags that edge. Missing or null is 216.

ui.layout.trackHeight.description: macOS only until Windows WV1: the timeline's track height (S, M or L: V1 28 / 36 / 52, A1 32 / 44 / 64, CC 20 / 24 / 28 pt; ux/v2 notes.md section 6), kept for every project after the user picks one. Missing is medium. No shared default, so it is absent from the Windows defaults.

general.showLowConfidence.description: Dashed underline on low-confidence words. design.md section 4.1.

general.showPlaceholderWords.description: Show transcript words on placeholders: caption cards show the scope's opening words; when false they show the project title. design.md section 5.4.2.

general.openLastProject.description: Windows: open the most recent project at launch. macOS restores windows through the system and ignores this key.

general.recentProjects.description: Windows only: absolute paths of recently opened projects, most recent first (macOS uses NSDocumentController's list).

editing.pauseBreath.description: Pause breath: tight 0.05 s, natural 0.15 s, relaxed 0.30 s (editing spec pauseKeepSeconds). New projects take it at import; changing it applies setPauseKeep to every open project, one undo step each. design.md section 4.2.

captions.defaultStyleId.description: Caption style id for new projects (a style in shared/caption-styles/styles, or "off"). design.md section 10.

clipStyle.default.description: The clip style a new project's clip style card starts with (design.md section 6.6): a project clipStyle without captionPicks. Saved whenever the user chooses on the card.

tone.description: As the project clipStyle.tone: omitted is Auto.

clips.mode.description: Who makes the clips of every new video (design.md section 6.6): claude runs Make top N postable by itself after transcription and Find Clips, within clips.autopilot.capUSD; pick leaves it to the creator. Missing means not chosen yet: the editor asks once, inline ("Who makes the clips?"). No default.

clips.autopilot.count.description: Claude mode: how many of the best suggestions Claude makes postable per video (design.md section 6.7).

clips.autopilot.capUSD.description: Claude mode: the most a video may spend on paid voice and generated music, USD (design.md section 6.7). Choosing it is the approval; 0 means no paid voice or music. A run that needs more stops at the cap and asks inline.

rewrite.myTones.description: The user's saved Rewrite tones (design.md section 6.3.1, "+ Save as my tone"), in the order saved; missing means none. Settings › Clips renames and deletes them. They show after the catalogue tones (shared/data/rewrite-tones.json) as chips and in the clip style card's Tone menu. instruction is the exact text Rewrite sends (at most 1,000 UTF-8 bytes, checked by the apps).

transcription.engineMode.description: transcription.md section 11.1. "apple" is macOS only; a Windows reader treats it as "local".

transcription.language.description: Default language for new imports: "auto" or a BCP 47 primary subtag. The import sheet's "Remember for new imports" writes it. transcription.md section 11.1.

transcription.recentLanguages.description: Most recent first; orders the import sheet's language list.

transcription.elevenlabs.region.description: Base URL for every ElevenLabs call. transcription.md section 8.1.

transcription.cloudConsent.elevenlabs.description: The first-use ElevenLabs upload sheet was accepted. transcription.md section 8.5.

export.defaultAspect.description: New projects copy it into export.aspect. design.md section 10, Export.

export.quality.description: New projects copy it into export.quality.

export.srt.description: New projects copy it into export.srt ("Burn in + .srt").

export.folder.description: Default export folder; null is the platform default (architecture.md section 2.5).

update.latestVersion.description: macOS only (Velopack keeps its own state on Windows).

update.htmlURL.description: macOS only; must be an https://github.com/ URL.

llm.connector.description: Connector id from shared/catalog/llm-providers.json, or empty (none chosen; nothing is preselected). ai.md section 8.2.

voiceLab.enabled.description: M3 beta: Settings → Voice Lab → Show Voice Lab. The shipped default is false; development builds read an unset key as true and never write it. voice-lab.md section 5.

voiceLab.betaNoticeAccepted.description: The shipped default is false; development builds read an unset key as true and never write it. voice-lab.md section 5.

voiceLab.rewriteVoice.description: The consent record id Rewrite starts with when that voice is listed, set by Settings › Voices "Use the new voice for Rewrite" after a rebuild (voice-lab.md section 6.12). No default: missing means the first listed voice. Mac only so far; Windows ignores it.

^llm\\.model\\.[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$.description: Model id per connector (never one shared key). Default: the catalog defaultModel.

^llm\\.cloudConsent\\.[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0.description: First-use consent per thirdPartyCloud connector. ai.md section 4.8.

^voiceLab\\.monthlyCapUsd\\.[a-z0-9]+(?:.description: Settings → Voice Lab → "Warn me above $__ a month per provider": a USD amount as a decimal string, or null for no cap. It has no default. voice-lab.md section 3.1.
